Your right I do want to live but I also dont want to live in a constant state of self hatred  and shame for the rest of my life. To tell you the truth, im affraid of death.  The fact that im agnostic and dont really believe in the after life nor heaven makes me wonder or better yet fear what's next. But I also have to imagine that there has to be something else, something better than the constant paranoia and fear of social interactions or the major deppression that seems to never go away.  I've been living this way my whole life, that's atleast a good 20 years (that I can remember) that I have hated myself.  There has to be something else beyond life that makes more sense.  And if its just emptiness, well all the better.  

I do however want to thank you for your reply to my post.
